_note: Repeat groups arise because 260 families share 78 prompts; each group is independent calls at identical settings, so it measures runtime variance.
_LIMITATION_within_run_only: These 49 groups are repeats WITHIN a single generation pass. The v1 floor was measured ACROSS separate runs (r0/r1/r2). They are not directly comparable: within-run repeats share session and batching conditions, and the v1 evidence showed variance is bimodal with mode selection plausibly tied to batching. A within-run floor can therefore understate across-run variance.
_across_run_v2_evidence: Limited: volatile.r1/r2 give across-run observations for 3 families only. prose:cekAman::0001 and prose:tanyaDokumen::0001 were stable across 3 runs; prose:umum::0000 showed 2 modes. So across-run variance is NOT zero under v2, even though the within-run metric floor is.
_use: Do not treat 0.0 as the across-run floor. A true v2 across-run floor requires re-running the expanded set and comparing passes.
